name: forward-implementation-first
title_zh: 先出活再记账，别让台账卡住真进度
tagline_zh: 多阶段流水线、迁移、长跑实施里，Agent 常被哈希锁、验收章、仪表盘这类台账卡住。装上它，先产出可验证结果。
tagline_en: In multi-stage pipelines, migrations, or long runs, agents stall on hash locks, cert markers, dashboards. This.
desc_en: Keeps an agent building and validating real output instead of servicing its own bookkeeping. Use for multi-stage pipelines, capability roadmaps, long-running implementation loops, migrations, staged data or build runs, and any run where administrative hashes, locks, receipts, dashboards, certification markers, or progress metadata can block correct work. Use when an agent refuses to advance, rewin
why_zh: 它把「行政性记账」和「实质推进」拆成两套优先级：记账永远可延迟、可跳过，而产物必须真实可验。
why_en: It hard-splits administrative bookkeeping from substantive progress—logs are always deferrable, but artifacts must be.
limit_zh: 只适用于有明确中间产物或可验证输出的多阶段任务；若单步产出无法独立验证（如纯对话推理），它会失效。
limit_en: Only for multi-stage tasks with verifiable intermediate artifacts; fails on pure conversational reasoning. Doesn't fix permission/env errors—just.
title_en: Build first, bookkeep later—don't let logs stall real work
